quote_zh: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
arithmetic_check: Nothing to close, and nothing wrong. Every stoichiometry is a ratio range against the benzoate salt: salt to alcohol 1:(1.05 to 1.35) (claim 5), salt to basic substance 1:(1.2 to 1.5) (claim 6), salt to alkali metal alkoxide 1:(1.2 to 1.5) (claim 7, restated in claim 10), solvent 700 to 3500 mL per mol of salt (claim 8). Conditions are -5 to 15 degrees C, a reaction time of 3 to 6 h, a salt addition time of 1 to 3 h and a post-acidification pH of 2 to 3. No absolute charge, mass or yield is stated, so no mass balance and no molar mass check can be computed and neither arithmetic flag is raised. Two open points for A5, both recorded in notes rather than flagged because no listed flag fits: claim 1 has step (2) give the free acid directly while claim 8 and claim 10 make the acidification the operation that gives it, and claim 7's alcohol plus alkali metal alkoxide preparation is a third transformation that the claims recite without any charge or isolation and that claim 10 omits, so it was not given a record of its own.
